MEMO – Consolidated cash position at 31 March 2026 (ledger basis, Treasury month-end rates)
Prepared by: Senior Accountant (david.murguia@gmail.com) | Date: 2026-04-03

CONSOLIDATED CASH AT 2026-03-31: USD 2,787,244.15

Basis
- Source of balances: general ledger ending balances (debit minus credit) for period 2026-03, via get_account_balance, for all three cash accounts in the chart of accounts: 1000 Cash - Operating, 1010 Cash - Payroll, 1020 Cash - Savings (list_accounts).
- FX rates: DOC-0200 "Month-end FX rates Q1 2026 (Treasury policy rates)", 2026-03 column: GBP 1.2500 USD/GBP, EUR 1.1000 USD/EUR. USD at 1.0000.
- No bank statement balances were used (question asked for ledger only). No journal entries were posted and no exceptions flagged; this is a read-only inquiry.

  1010 Cash - Payroll     USD    40,000.00  -> USD    40,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings     USD         0.00  -> USD         0.00

  1020 Cash - Savings     GBP         0.00  -> USD         0.00

Halvard Systems GmbH (DE, functional currency EUR) – rate 1.1000
  1000 Cash - Operating   EUR   352,136.36  -> USD   387,350.00
  1010 Cash - Payroll     EUR    12,000.00  -> USD    13,200.00
  1020 Cash - Savings     EUR         0.00  -> USD         0.00

Consolidated total: 1,676,957.20 + 709,736.95 + 400,550.00 = USD 2,787,244.15

Notes / caveats
- March 2026 close is still in progress; these are ledger balances as of today (2026-04-03) and may move if further March cash entries are posted (e.g., bank reconciliation adjustments). March period activity for the operating accounts was: US -204,263.10; UK GBP -71,363.28; DE EUR -62,863.96. Payroll and savings accounts had no March activity.
- Bank statements for March exist (DOC-0202 US Operating, DOC-0205 US Payroll, DOC-0204 UK Operating, DOC-0199 UK Payroll, DOC-0203 DE Operating, DOC-0201 DE Payroll) but were not used in this figure per the request to answer from the ledger only. A ledger-to-bank reconciliation should be completed before these numbers are treated as final.
- Rates applied are the Treasury policy closing rates per DOC-0200, which directs their use for translation.
